text:
Sofia: Hey finance — FYI my corpcard had a hotel pre-auth for 20.00 but the final charge posted as 1,215.20 and it pushed me over my travel card limit. I paid 5.20 on my personal card for incidentals.
Ben: ouch, what's the hotel name/folio number?
Sofia: Hotel Alte Stadt, folio #HS-99321. Attached final folio PDF and swipe screenshot: https://files.redwood/sofia/hs99321-folio.pdf and https://img.redwood.internal/sofia/hotel-swipe.jpg
Ravi: Does the corpcard actually show the 1,215.20 charge? Sometimes final posts later as the pre-auth settles.
Sofia: Yes it posted overnight and the card provider debited the full amount. Pre-auth was 20 but final hit for room + city tax + minibar/parking. I have itemized folio that shows the 5.20 minibar charge that I covered personally.
FinanceBot: Reminder: policy requires an itemized hotel folio and manager approval for reimbursable personal payments. See https://wiki.redwood/expenses#hotel-exceptions
Nina: @Sofia can you confirm this was an approved trip and the room was booked on company travel policy?
Sofia: Yes PRJ-401 approved. Booking via Concur under account `redwood-travel`.
Ben: @Nina I can confirm Sofia's trip was approved.
Nina: Ok — finance will reimburse the 5.20 if Sofia uploads the folio + the personal card receipt into Expensify and tags me. Also we need to code the reversal if the corpcard charge is disputed successfully.
Sofia: Uploaded Expensify TXN `EXP-421007` with folio and personal AMEX receipt (last4 8801). Note says: "Hotel final > pre-auth, personal covered minibar 5.20"
FinanceBot: Auto-check: Expensify TXN present, folio matches final amount, manager match = true. Attachments verified = folio.pdf, amex-receipt.jpg.
Ravi: For card provider disputes: if we prove pre-auth difference and merchant error, provider may reverse the hotel amount. We should hold off reimbursing until provider verdict? Otherwise we risk double pay.
Nina: Given this is a small amount and employee hardship, we can make an exception to reimburse the personal portion now and create a reconciliation hold. Finance, please code reimbursement to GL 6421:employee-travel and open dispute ticket.
Ben: Agreed, expedite the 5.20.
ProcurementBot: Note: card provider disputes typically take 7-21 days. Whitelist request not applicable.
FinanceBot: Created dispute ticket CARDDISP-901 by Nina at 2024-06-12T14:02Z. Hold flag set on TXN EXP-421007.
FinanceBot: Reimbursement scheduled: 5.20 via payroll adjustment (next cycle). Coding: GL 6421.
Sofia: Thank you! Saved all receipts in case provider asks.
Nina: Closing loop: reimbursed for personal portion, dispute ongoing for full hotel charge. If provider reverses, we'll adjust corpcard billing and notify you. :thumbsup:
Sofia: Appreciated, really helps with cashflow. :pray:
